_comment: P2-020: a creature standing still on the floor (horizontal speed < still_speed for settle_s) joins grass_field's grass_clear group with radius body_radius * radius_scale, so runtime grass thins and shortens around its feet instead of burying them. It leaves the group on its first moving frame. Runtime grass only; enabled false restores the old behaviour.

p2_020_candidate._why: P2-020 (vis-meadows, 1 Nov, OFF until GPU-judged): today's re-score still reads the hare's and owlet's feet as buried in grass. A creature joins the clearing only when it stands still (< 0.15 m/s for 0.6 s), so a wild creature ambling through its wander never clears its feet. On: the clearing also holds while it ambles (< 0.7 m/s, after 0.3 s), over a wider disc (body radius x2.1). The grass field already re-reads clearings when a creature joins or leaves.
